# Definition reference

<!-- Generated by scripts/generate_reference.py from the GradingDefinition JSON Schema. Do not edit; run `python scripts/generate_reference.py` after changing a contract. -->

Every field of a grading definition, as the [v1 JSON Schema](../contracts/v1/grading-definition.schema.json) publishes it. Omitted optional fields take the default shown. Each criterion's `parameters` are described per evaluator in the [evaluator reference](evaluators.md); rules JSON Schema cannot express are in [DEFINITIONS.md](../contracts/DEFINITIONS.md).

## GradingDefinition {#gradingdefinition}

One assignment's complete grading definition (version 1).

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Constraints | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `schema_version` | `"1.0"` | yes | — | — | Definition format version. |
| `templates` | list of string | yes | — | ≥ 1 items | Distinct template identifiers whose evaluators the criteria may use. |
| `languages` | list of `"python"` or `"java"` or `"node"` or `"cpp"` or `"c"` | yes | — | ≥ 1 items | Distinct languages a submission may use; with several, each submission names its language. |
| `criteria` | [CriteriaConfig](#criteriaconfig) | yes | — | — | The weighted criteria tree. |
| `preparation` | [Preparation](#preparation) | no | each field's default | — | Required files, fixtures and setup commands. |
| `feedback` | [Feedback](#feedback) | no | each field's default | — | Feedback report policy. |
| `metadata` | map of string to any JSON value | no | `{}` | — | Free-form JSON stored with the definition; never interpreted by grading. |

## CriteriaConfig {#criteriaconfig}

Root configuration for grading criteria.

Location: `criteria`

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Constraints | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `base` | [CategoryConfig](#categoryconfig) | yes | — | — | Criteria that make up the score (weight 100). |
| `bonus` | [CategoryConfig](#categoryconfig) or null | no | `null` | — | Criteria whose score adds up to their weight in points. |
| `penalty` | [CategoryConfig](#categoryconfig) or null | no | `null` | — | Criteria whose shortfall subtracts up to their weight in points. |
| `metadata` | map of string to any JSON value | no | `{}` | — | Free-form JSON stored with the definition; never interpreted by grading. |

## CategoryConfig {#categoryconfig}

Configuration for a grading category (base, bonus, or penalty).

Location: `criteria.base`, `criteria.bonus`, `criteria.penalty`

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Constraints | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `weight` | number | yes | — | ≥ 0; ≤ 100 | Base must be 100; bonus and penalty weights (0-100) cap the points they add or subtract. |
| `tests` | list of [TestConfig](#testconfig) or null | no | `null` | — | Criteria directly under this category; null when it has none. |
| `subjects` | list of [SubjectConfig](#subjectconfig) or null | no | `null` | — | Subjects nested in this category; null when it has none. |
| `subjects_weight` | number or null | no | `null` | ≥ 0; ≤ 100 | Share (0-100) of this group's score taken from its subjects when it has both tests and subjects; its tests get the rest. Required for such mixed groups and rejected otherwise. |
| `metadata` | map of string to any JSON value | no | `{}` | — | Free-form JSON stored with the definition; never interpreted by grading. |

## TestConfig {#testconfig}

One criterion: an evaluator invocation with its parameters.

Location: `criteria.base.tests[]`, `criteria.base.subjects[].tests[]`

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Constraints | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | string | yes | — | length ≥ 1; length ≤ 128; matches `^[A-Za-z0-9_.:-]+$` | Stable identifier, unique in the definition; results, feedback links and comparisons use it. |
| `type` | string (one of 46 values) | yes | — | length ≥ 1 | Evaluator identifier from one of the listed templates. |
| `name` | string | yes | — | length ≥ 1 | Display name; may repeat. |
| `parameters` | map of string to any JSON value | yes | — | — | The evaluator's parameters ({} when it has none); each evaluator documents its own. |
| `file` | string or null | no | `null` | length ≥ 1 | Exact relative submission path to assess; null selects the evaluator's matching files. |
| `weight` | number | no | `100.0` | ≥ 0 | Weight relative to sibling criteria; all-zero siblings share equally. |
| `metadata` | map of string to any JSON value | no | `{}` | — | Free-form JSON stored with the definition; never interpreted by grading. |

## SubjectConfig {#subjectconfig}

Configuration for a subject within a grading category.

Location: `criteria.base.subjects[]`

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Constraints | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `subject_name` | string | yes | — | length ≥ 1 | Display name of the subject. |
| `weight` | number | yes | — | ≥ 0; ≤ 100 | Weight (0-100) relative to sibling subjects; all-zero siblings share equally. |
| `tests` | list of [TestConfig](#testconfig) or null | no | `null` | — | Criteria directly under this subject; null when it has none. |
| `subjects` | list of [SubjectConfig](#subjectconfig) or null | no | `null` | — | Subjects nested in this subject; null when it has none. |
| `subjects_weight` | number or null | no | `null` | ≥ 0; ≤ 100 | Share (0-100) of this group's score taken from its subjects when it has both tests and subjects; its tests get the rest. Required for such mixed groups and rejected otherwise. |
| `metadata` | map of string to any JSON value | no | `{}` | — | Free-form JSON stored with the definition; never interpreted by grading. |

## Preparation {#preparation}

What must exist and run before any criterion is assessed.

Location: `preparation`

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Constraints | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `languages` | map of `python` or `java` or `node` or `cpp` or `c` to [LanguagePreparation](#languagepreparation) | no | `{}` | — | Preparation keyed by allowed language; only the submission's language is used. |
| `fixtures` | list of [Fixture](#fixture) | no | `[]` | — | Files staged for every language. |

## LanguagePreparation {#languagepreparation}

Preparation for one allowed language.

Location: `preparation.languages.<language>`

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Constraints | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `required_files` | list of string | no | `[]` | — | Unique relative submission paths that must exist; a missing one fails with REQUIRED_FILE_MISSING before any sandbox is acquired. |
| `setup_commands` | list of [SetupCommand](#setupcommand) | no | `[]` | — | Steps run in order after fixtures are staged, for example compilation. A failing step stops grading with PREPARATION_FAILED. |

## SetupCommand {#setupcommand}

One preparation step, run once before assessment in the selected language's sandbox.

Location: `preparation.languages.<language>.setup_commands[]`

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Constraints | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | string | yes | — | length ≥ 1 | Label of the step, shown when it fails. |
| `command` | string | yes | — | length ≥ 1 | Executable and arguments, split with POSIX quoting and run without a shell. Standalone shell operators (&&, \|, ;, >, ...) are rejected: use one setup command per step, and an explicit `sh -c '...'` command only for a real pipeline. |

## Fixture {#fixture}

A host-provided file staged into the sandbox before setup commands.

Location: `preparation.fixtures[]`

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Constraints | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `reference` | string | yes | — | length ≥ 1 | Logical relative reference resolved by the host's fixture provider (an object key on the shipped hosts). |
| `path` | string | yes | — | — | Unique relative destination under the fixture root (/tmp/app on the shipped hosts). |
| `read_only` | boolean | no | `true` | — | Whether the staged file is read-only to the submission. |

## Feedback {#feedback}

Whether and how a feedback report is written for a completed grade.

Location: `feedback`

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Constraints | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `enabled` | boolean | no | `false` | — | Whether a feedback report is rendered; disabled feedback does no work. |
| `mode` | `"default"` | no | `"default"` | — | Report format; only the Markdown default exists. |
| `preferences` | [FeedbackPreferences](#feedbackpreferences) | no | each field's default | — | Report options. |

## FeedbackPreferences {#feedbackpreferences}

How the feedback report is written.

Location: `feedback.preferences`

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Constraints | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `general` | [GeneralPreferences](#generalpreferences) | no | each field's default | — | Options for every mode. |
| `default` | [DefaultPreferences](#defaultpreferences) | no | each field's default | — | Options of the default mode. |

## GeneralPreferences {#generalpreferences}

Report options shared by every feedback mode.

Location: `feedback.preferences.general`

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Constraints | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `report_title` | string or null | no | `null` | — | Report heading; null uses the localized default title. |
| `show_score` | boolean | no | `true` | — | Whether the report shows the final score. |
| `show_passed_tests` | boolean | no | `false` | — | Whether criteria that scored 100 are listed; by default only criteria below 100 are. |
| `add_report_summary` | boolean | no | `true` | — | Whether the report starts with a score summary. |
| `online_content` | list of [LearningResource](#learningresource) | no | `[]` | — | Learning resources listed at the end of the report. |

## LearningResource {#learningresource}

A link listed in the feedback report.

Location: `feedback.preferences.general.online_content[]`

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Constraints | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `url` | string | yes | — | length ≥ 1 | Address of the resource. |
| `description` | string | yes | — | — | Link text shown in the report. |
| `linked_tests` | list of string | no | `[]` | — | Criterion IDs; the resource is shown only when one of them scored below 100. Empty shows it always. |

## DefaultPreferences {#defaultpreferences}

Options of the default Markdown report.

Location: `feedback.preferences.default`

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Constraints | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `category_headers` | map of `base` or `bonus` or `penalty` to string | no | `{}` | — | Section heading per category; a missing category uses its localized default heading. |
